snippet.description:
Limoges’ historic town hall was largely destroyed after rioters broke into the building and set it alight during unrest in France on Saturday. Footage showed its spire collapsing as firefighters battled the blaze at the landmark, which opened in 1883.

The destruction came during nationwide demonstrations over living costs and public services. While many protesters marched peacefully, violence and looting broke out in several cities. French authorities condemned the attacks, and President Emmanuel Macron said those responsible would be prosecuted.

Alex Phillips discusses the unrest with comedian and commentator Paul Cox.

snippet.title: What Causes Mouth Ulcers? Common Triggers Explained #MouthUlcers #OralHealth #CankerSores
snippet.description:
Why do mouth ulcers appear—and why do some people keep getting them? These painful sores can make eating, drinking, and speaking uncomfortable.

In this video, we explore common causes and possible triggers of mouth ulcers, including accidentally biting your cheek and irritation from sharp teeth, braces, or dentures. We also discuss factors associated with recurring ulcers, such as stress and certain nutritional deficiencies.

The exact cause of recurrent canker sores is often unclear. Repeated ulcers do not automatically mean you have a vitamin deficiency or a serious illness.

👄 In this video:
• Common injuries and irritation that can cause ulcers
• Possible triggers of recurring canker sores
• Why persistent or frequent ulcers deserve attention
• When to seek advice from a dentist or doctor

Most common mouth ulcers heal within one to two weeks. Have an ulcer checked if it lasts longer than three weeks, becomes unusually painful, bleeds, or looks different from your usual ulcers.

사장은 물통을 빼앗고 그 자리에서 그녀를 해고합니다.
다음 날 아침, 할머니가 봉투 하나를 들고 다시 문을 엽니다.

비 오는 날 폐지 줍는 할머니에게 물 한 잔을 건넸다는 이유로 해고 통보를 받은 청년. 다음 날, 가게를 다시 찾아온 할머니의 정체가 밝혀집니다.

가게 안에서 비를 피하며 폐지를 줍는 할머니를 걱정 어린 시선으로 바라보던 한 남자. 남자는 할머니의 고단한 처지를 안타까워하며, 계약이 끝나면 더 나은 곳에서 함께 폐지를 주워보자고 따뜻한 제안을 건넵니다. 하지만 이 작은 친절은 예상치 못한 결과를 불러오게 됩니다.

착한 마음으로 베푼 호의가 오히려 독이 되어 돌아온 상황, 종업원은 하루아침에 일자리를 잃고 맙니다. 그러나 다음 날, 남자를 찾아온 할머니의 놀라운 정체와 반전은 보는 이들의 마음을 다시 한번 울립니다. 진정한 사람의 도리가 무엇인지 생각하게 하는 가슴 뭉클한 인생 드라마를 구독하고 함께 나누어 주세요.

매주 전해드리는 따뜻한 인생 이야기를 구독하고 응원해 주세요.

snippet.title: DIY Almirah Makeover under budget 💵😱 #diyhomedecor #interiordesign #ytshortsindia
snippet.description:
DIY Almirah Makeover under budget 💵😱 #diyhomedecor #interiordesign #ytshortsindia 

DIY aisa karo ki 4 लोग aake puche, "bhai kaha se khareeda" 🤪 Kaisa laga ye almirah transformation, was I successful in giving it a whole new look - YESS 👍🏻or NOO 👎🏻 bata do comments me!

When it first clicked my mind ki chalo purane iron almirah ko naya banate hai, I knew ise mujhe wooden look dena tha, mainly monochromatic with dash of a contrasting shade.

Here’s everything I did for the makeover -

➡️ We start with scraping off the old paint using a grinder. If your old paint is completely intact hasn't come off anywhere), you can directly go painting a new coat and skip this tedious process.

➡️ Next we go to structural changes. Wanted to have a wooden look, so panelling kiya front and side pe using wooden trims. Similarly gave it a wooden top head and bottom base.

➡️ All wooden trim panels can be glued using liquid nails and corners can be filled with wood filler.

➡️ You can add a layer of metal primer first (I missed showing here in the video) Then we start with painting - Simply paint ka dabba kholo, pour and start applying using a roller/brush.

➡️ Finally, maine kuch wall decals lagaye lotus ke, cane handles attach kiya & made 2 panels of bamboo mat in between to slightly break the monotony.

snippet.title: Why Is Air Pumped Under the Duck's Skin Before Roasting? 😲🍗#core  #Shorts
snippet.description:
Have you ever wondered how chefs prepare duck with incredibly crispy skin? 🍗 In some traditional Chinese cooking methods, air is introduced between the duck's skin and underlying tissue to help separate them. The duck may then be treated with hot water and other preparation steps before roasting. This process helps the skin dry and become crisp during cooking, creating the texture that makes famous dishes such as Peking duck so popular. 🔥 The technique combines careful preparation, temperature control, and roasting to achieve its distinctive result. Food preparation methods can vary between kitchens, and professional chefs follow appropriate food-safety practices throughout the process.
